description: This file defines an abstract class 'DatabaseAbstract' which provides methods for handling database-like data ranges in the context of calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for evaluating, extracting fields, filtering, building queries, and processing data rows based on criteria.

classes.name: DatabaseAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing static methods for handling database-like data structures, including evaluation, filtering, and query building based on criteria, within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate a database against criteria; implementation required in subclasses.

methods.name: fieldExtract
methods.description: Extracts the column index based on a field name or position from a database range.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters database rows to match specific criteria, returning matching subset.

methods.name: getFilteredColumn
methods.description: Retrieves a specific column of data from the filtered database.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Constructs a string query representing criteria for database filtering.

methods.name: buildCondition
methods.description: Builds individual condition strings, including wildcard matching and logical operators.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes the constructed query on the database, filtering rows accordingly.

methods.name: processCondition
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in conditions with actual data values for row evaluation.
